# GageBlockCalc

Free gage block stack calculator for inch 81-, 36-, and 28-piece sets and metric 112- and 88-piece sets. No login. Recipe pages below were built by that same solver and each stack adds up to the stated size.

## Tools
- Calculator: https://gageblockcalc.com/
- Common shop sizes: https://gageblockcalc.com/calculators/stacks/
- Sine bar stack height: https://gageblockcalc.com/calculators/sine-bar-gage-block-stack.html
- Inch 81-piece guide: https://gageblockcalc.com/calculators/inch-gage-block-stack.html
- Inch 36-piece guide: https://gageblockcalc.com/calculators/inch-36-gage-block-stack.html
- Inch 28-piece guide: https://gageblockcalc.com/calculators/inch-28-gage-block-stack.html
- Metric sets: https://gageblockcalc.com/calculators/metric-gage-block-stack.html
- Metric 112-piece guide: https://gageblockcalc.com/calculators/metric-112-gage-block-stack.html
- Metric 88-piece guide: https://gageblockcalc.com/calculators/metric-88-gage-block-stack.html
- Wear blocks: https://gageblockcalc.com/calculators/wear-block-stack.html
- Embed the widget: https://gageblockcalc.com/embed.html
- FAQ: https://gageblockcalc.com/faq.html

## AskMachinist
- How to wring gage blocks: https://askmachinist.com/guides/how-to-wring-gage-blocks
- How to choose a gage block set: https://askmachinist.com/guides/how-to-choose-a-gage-block-set
- How to build a gage block stack: https://askmachinist.com/guides/how-to-build-a-gage-block-stack
- Temperature correction: https://askmachinist.com/tools/gage-block-temperature-correction
- Worked stacks already published: https://askmachinist.com/gage-block-stacks/
